headline: The Haunting Music in the ‘Odyssey’ Siren Scene Has Ancient Roots
context: Ludwig Göransson’s soundtrack for Christopher Nolan’s film resurrects an ancient instrument, the aulos, to evoke the tormenting allure of the sirens.

sources.name: The New York Times
